decisive_items: She had been diagnosed with a tenosynovial giant cell tumor by MRI at a local hospital
homogeneous enhancement of the tendons and synovial membrane, supporting synovial hyperplasia
diffusion-weighted imaging and ADC maps suggested restricted diffusion
response.rationale: The vignette includes a prior MRI diagnosis of tenosynovial giant cell tumor, and current imaging shows homogeneous synovial enhancement and restricted diffusion, typical of this neoplastic process. Inflammatory candidates like synovitis (R4) or tenosynovitis (R2) are less specific given the DWI restriction and prior diagnosis, while degenerative arthritis (R3) is only a minor finding.

rejected.why: Findings are more consistent with a neoplastic process than simple tenosynovitis; DWI restriction and prior tumor diagnosis support R1.
Degenerative changes in carpal bones are minor and not the dominant presentation; symptoms and imaging favor a soft-tissue lesion.
Synovial enhancement is present but is a feature of the tumor; the prior diagnosis and DWI restriction make synovitis alone less likely.
